description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)，查看当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of your WAF instance.

description.zh: 密钥版本。当前仅支持取值为1。
description.en: The version of the AppKey. Set the value to 1.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-bot-app-key --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-5v23u000000 --key-version 1 --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-aek2uo27badl000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
